create_env_transfer_cube: create an AlohaEnv with transfer_cube task and pixels observation type
create_env_insertion: create an AlohaEnv with insertion task and pixels_agent_pos observation type
run_env_step: run the AlohaEnv step method with an action array and return observation, reward, terminated, truncated, and info
reset_env_with_seed: reset the AlohaEnv with a seed to initialize random box pose for transfer_cube or insertion tasks
render_env_rgb: render the AlohaEnv as an rgb_array image from the top camera view
